**Summary**
A short, descriptive summary of the feature requested.

**Problem / Use case**
Describe the problem this feature solves or the user need.

**Proposed solution**
Describe the proposed change in enough detail to guide implementation (examples, API, UX, etc.).

**Alternatives considered**
List other approaches you considered and why they were not preferred.
